attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates nobody: it is a company of seventy and the page names one of them only, saying that «Ένας από αυτούς, ο Άγιος Βασίλειος τιμάται και στις 6 Ιουλίου» — one of them, Saint Basil, is honoured on 6 July as well. A heading that names nobody is one entry, so this is one folder and not seventy, and the Basil of 6 Ιουλίου is named in the reader's report and not drafted, that day not having been read. The corpus keeps four other saints of Scythopolis, none of them a company and none on 28 June. No year and no persecutor are given. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
